QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` (`:42`) is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set (default on, `mbedtls_config.h:52`) and a GNU or ARMCC compiler is detected.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler detection, which conveys that it is derived rather than set directly in the config.
